_comment: Registry of validate-test benchmark cases. Each entry defines a nuclease/guide benchmark with a precomputed brute-force ground truth. To add a new example: append an entry, generate its reference with test/benchmark/generate_references.py, host the TSV, and record its md5. validate.py iterates this registry, downloads+caches each reference (keyed by md5), and reports per-case pass/fail. A case may add a per-case "thresholds" object overriding the global set; include "max_total_edits" to validate the DEFAULT single-'n edits' web mode (per-type caps left wide open, the total cap binding). A case whose reference is not yet generated (md5 "TODO-after-generation" and no committed TSV) is SKIPPED, not failed. A case marked "heavy": true builds a bulge-2 (NGG_3/TTTV_3) index over the variant-enriched genome, which exceeds a standard 16GB hosted CI runner (OOM, or too slow under swap); complete_test.py/validate.py skip "heavy" cases when CRISPRME_SKIP_HEAVY=1 (set by the hosted CI job), so they run locally / on a larger runner but not on the default PR runner. They are validated locally (4/4) and their references are committed for reproduction.
